title: A Study to Assess the Change in Disease Activity and Adverse Events of AGN-151607-DP for the Treatment of Major Depressive Disorder in Adult Participants
official: A Phase 2, Multicenter, Double-Blind, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Parallel-Group Study with an Open-Label Treatment Period to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of AGN-151607-DP (USAN: gemibotulinumtoxinA) for the Treatment of Major Depressive Disorder
summary: Main objective: Evaluate the antidepressant efficacy of AGN-151607-DP as a monotherapy compared to placebo in participants with MDD.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male and female subjects from 18 to 70 years of age, inclusive, at the time of informed consent.
2. Have at least 1 prior episode meeting the DSM-5-TR criteria for MDD.
3. Subject has a BMI of ≥ 18 to ≤ 45.
4. Current major depressive episode meets the following criteria: HAM-D17 total score ≥ 22, CGI-S-MDD score ≥ 4, and episode duration of ≥ 4 weeks, but no more than 24 months.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants have treatment resistance in the current episode (defined as an inadequate response with < 50% improvement of depressive symptoms to 2 or more antidepressant treatments of adequate.
2. Concurrent antidepressant medication(s) or herbal/homeopathic remedies targeting signs and symptoms of depression within 2 weeks or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer
3. Lifetime history of meeting DSM-5-TR criteria for: -- Schizophrenia spectrum or other psychotic disorder -- Bipolar disorder -- Major neurocognitive disorder -- Neurodevelopmental disorder of greater than mild severity or of a severity that impacts the subject's ability to consent, follow study directions, or otherwise safely participate in the study -- Dissociative disorder -- Post-traumatic stress disorder
